_doc: UI-test av målningen i The Character Creator (studio/human_paint.js): syssling_wrap20 öppnas, Paint the skin… startar läget (bara målningens kort syns), en röd pensel på magen hamnar i texturen där penseln var och speglad på andra sidan men inte på ryggen, Undo tar bort den, en referensbild projiceras med sina egna färger, en bild laddas upp som referens, och Save skriver en ny _paint_v<n>_color.png som Finished model ser som färgkarta. Ta bort assets/characters/syssling_wrap20/syssling_wrap20_paint_v* och build/human/refs/syssling_wrap20 efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator_paint

steps.expect: (() => { const vis = [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside > .card')].filter((c) => getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none'); return vis.length === 1 && vis[0].classList.contains('hu-paint'); })()
steps.label: Paint the skin opens the paint mode with only its card

steps.eval: (() => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test, r = innerWidth / 2; const h = T.hit(innerWidth / 2, innerHeight * 0.5); window.__back = h; return h; })()

(() => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test; const cx = T.cx; const s = T.screen([cx + 0.07, 1.0, 0.1]); let h = null; for (let dy = 0; dy < 200 && !h; dy += 10) h = T.hit(s[0], innerHeight * 0.5 + dy); window.__a = { s: [s[0], innerHeight * 0.5], h }; const m = T.screen([2 * cx - h.p[0], h.p[1], h.p[2]]); window.__b = T.hit(m[0], m[1]); window.__base = T.texel(...h.uv); return { a: window.__a, b: window.__b, base: window.__base, back: T.texel(...window.__back.uv) }; })()

steps.label: the brush finds the figure's front, its mirror point and its back
the even skin base is the skin colour #c9a48c as it is (sRGB in the texture)

steps.eval: (() => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test; T.set('tool', 'color'); T.set('color', '#3a7bd5'); T.set('strength', 1); T.set('hard', 0.6); T.set('radius', 22); T.set('mirror', false); T.stroke([T.screen(__a.h.p)]); window.__blue = T.texel(...__a.h.uv); T.undo(); return __blue; })()

steps.label: a full-strength dab of #3a7bd5 lands as exactly that colour

steps.eval: (() => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test; T.set('tool', 'color'); T.set('color', '#ff0000'); T.set('strength', 1); T.set('hard', 0.6); T.set('radius', 22); T.set('mirror', true); T.stroke([[__a.h ? T.screen(__a.h.p)[0] : 0, T.screen(__a.h.p)[1]]]); return { here: T.texel(...__a.h.uv), mirror: T.texel(...__b.uv), back: T.texel(...__back.uv) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test, a = T.texel(...__a.h.uv), b = T.texel(...__b.uv), k = T.texel(...__back.uv); return a[0] > 240 && a[1] < 20 && b[0] > 240 && b[1] < 20 && Math.abs(k[0] - __base[0]) < 4 && Math.abs(k[1] - __base[1]) < 4; })()
steps.label: a red dab lands under the brush and mirrored on the other side, not on the back

steps.eval: (async () => { const T = __studio.human.painter.test; await T.setPic('/assets/icons/human/woman.png'); const s = T.screen(__a.h.p); window.__pc = T.picColor(s[0], s[1]); T.set('opacity', 0.5); T.set('mirror', false); T.set('face', -0.2); T.project(); return { pic: T.pic, at: __pc, texel: T.texel(...__a.h.uv) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const c = __pc && [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(__pc.slice(i, i + 2), 16)), t = __studio.human.painter.test.texel(...__a.h.uv); return !!c && c.every((v, i) => Math.abs(v - t[i]) <= 24); })()
steps.label: Project the picture lays the reference's own colour on the figure where it lies over it

steps.eval: (async () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 64; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#3a7bd5'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64); const blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); const r = await fetch('/api/human/ref?name=syssling_wrap20&file=ui_test_ref.png', { method: 'POST', body: blob }).then((x) => x.json()); window.__ref = r; return r; })()

steps.label: a reference picture is saved per figure
Save writes a new colour map that the Finished card picks, and the figure lists its reference
Close leaves the paint mode and the cards come back
